label: Early original-phase steps (t=1..6) after/at a p or q input
explanation: Fires only during the original (input) phase, essentially never at t=0, the delimiter, or any copy step. Rate peaks at t=2-4 (orig_idx 3 has 3.5x lift) and decays to near zero by t=8. Within that window it is driven by token identity: the current or recent input being p or q (about 4x lift each), and more weakly u, 1, g, y, b, f. It is boosted on first occurrences of a token (in_first). The strongest activations (up to 0.49) come on runs like p p q or p p p early in the sequence. Gating to t=1..5 alone gives 0.92 recall but 0.13 precision. Adding the p/q-seen condition raises F1 to about 0.43 (mass recall 0.72), but many weak activations follow other tokens, and many p/q steps stay inactive. So it acts like a graded, token-weighted early-position unit, not a crisp detector.
